weeks.label: Week 3
weeks.theme: Outcomes: Evaluating What You Built, Then Building for Someone Else

activities.title: Usability Testing — Human & Agent (video)
activities.shortDescription: Individual, on your team's deployed Project 2 prototype: run two think-aloud human usability tests plus one agent-based test (an AI drives your live site), then cut it into one ≤5-minute subtitled video with a findings summary. No coding — you're the usability researcher today.

readings.cite: Nielsen, J. 1994. 10 Usability Heuristics for User Interface Design. Nielsen Norman Group.
UEQ — User Experience Questionnaire (evaluation instrument).

activities.title: Value Verification — Does It Embed the Value It Claims?
activities.shortDescription: Individual, on your team's Project 2 prototype: state the value your team claimed, operationalize it, then verify whether the built thing delivers it — through behavior, understanding, and affect, with a validated instrument (UEQ, an HRI/SDT scale, or the slop detector). Usability asks 'can they use it?'; value verification asks 'does it do the right thing?'

readings.cite: Flanagan, M., Nissenbaum, H. Values at Play — Verification: operationalize a value, then test whether the built thing realizes it (behavior · understanding · affect).
UEQ — User Experience Questionnaire: a validated scale measuring not just usability but attractiveness, novelty, and stimulation. Laugwitz, Held & Schrepp 2008.
HRI Scale Database (George Mason) — 'Finding the Perfect Scale': browse validated scales (trust, warmth, competence…) rated for psychometric quality, to test the value you claim.
METUX / Self-Determination Theory scales — measure autonomy, competence, and relatedness for wellbeing-oriented values. Peters, Calvo & Ryan 2018.
Vibed Slop Detector (Sandhaus/Hayatt), built on the impeccable.style 'slop' rules — flag generic AI-slop design tells as a proxy for craft, care, and originality.
Sandhaus, H., Rhomberg, D.M., Nissenbaum, H. 2026. Making Indecent Persuasion Visible: How Evaluation Metrics Shape UX Designers' Ethical Reasoning. CHIWORK '26 (LBW, preprint).
Romero, K., Wiese, I., Balancieri, R., Leal, G.C., Guerino, G. 2026. Usable but Conventional: An Empirical Study on the UX of AI-Generated Interface Prototypes (UEQ-S). arXiv:2605.15124.
Flanagan, M., Nissenbaum, H. Values at Play in Digital Games — full digital book.
